stumbles.quote: Colour matches a reference to ΔE76 0.07.
stumbles.why: The text never says what reference was used. A ΔE76 of 0.07 is also far below what people can see, so it's unclear what was compared.

stumbles.quote: black film spreads from the top
stumbles.why: It isn't explained that black film is the very thin stage just before a soap film pops. A reader who doesn't know that may not see why it appears.

stumbles.quote: thick film sinks the way you tilt the phone, thin rises
stumbles.why: This implies the sim reads the phone's tilt sensor. The next sentence then says it is untested on a real phone. It is unclear how tilt works on desktop, or whether the demo works at all.

point: The post shows a WebGPU compute simulation of a soap film in which thickness works like density, so thick film sinks toward the tilt direction and thin film rises. The film drains, forms black film, and pops. It's colour-matched to a reference, but it hasn't been tested on a real phone.
